x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a requester submits an idea or demand, When it is created, Then it is routed to the demand manager with required business case fields Given a demand is assessed, When scoring completes, Then value, risk and effort scores are stored and it appears on the prioritisation view
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: All new work enters through a single demand intake with a standard assessment
